scope: Minimal Enmity's Embrace reference, isolated manual-input contribution, and observed-value review contract for PoE1 3.29.1. It is not a sheet-derived, combat, or availability calculation.

retention.sourceLicense: PoB LICENSE.md grants MIT terms for software, while ring.lua is marked Item data (c) Grinding Gear Games. PoEDB describes site content as CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Neither statement establishes redistribution rights for underlying game item data.
retention.dataLicense: No affirmative right to redistribute raw unique-item tables or copied page content was established.
retention.provenance: Manually reviewed minimal item fields and isolated product math from the sources recorded in AUD-005.
retention.redistribution: Retention is limited to the small factual fields necessary to reproduce claims and synthetic gates; legal/policy review remains required before treating it as a redistribution basis.
retention.derivation: The manual formula is a narrowly documented product representation of the reviewed overcap concept, not a derivation of a Mercenary sheet or combat result.
retention.attribution: Grinding Gear Games, Path of Building Community, and PoEDB source locations and licence/terms limitations are recorded in the source registry and AUD-005.
retention.retainedMaterial: Item/base identity, small named natural ranges, dynamic-stat locator, item-specific cap, isolated formula terms, dependency manifest, and observed-value policy.
retention.notVendored: No raw PoB/PoEDB item table, source code, image, full tooltip, player item, or other upstream asset is vendored.
retention.uncertainty: Live 3.29.1 continuity, availability, sheet semantics, penalty order/rounding, aggregation, and damage effects remain unresolved.

records.evidenceLocation: PoB dev unique ring.lua, stat-description record 2919, ModParser.lua/CalcDefence.lua/CalcOffence.lua, 3.29 export commit 3a73a54bd3a9c92c4d3264c5d697a51b6c9063bc, and current PoEDB page recorded in AUD-005.
records.limitations: Neither source is an official target-version item record. Availability sources conflict and raw observed items do not prove a natural range, current offer, or ownership. The exact modifier sentence is retained only in AUD-005 evidence, not this runtime-ineligible artifact.
records.replacementRule: Replace only with a reviewed target-version structured item source and a superseding AUD-005.
